scenario: Amazon onsite 第一轮 OOD：给电商写 checkout 价格引擎，三种折扣（百分比、固定额、买X送Y），编码时间约 30 分钟，你刚读完题。
scenario_en: Amazon onsite round 1, OOD: build a checkout price engine with three discount kinds — percent off, fixed off, buy-X-get-Y. You have about 30 minutes of coding time and just finished reading the prompt.
q: 写第一个类之前，先说的那句话该是什么？
q_en: What should the first sentence out of your mouth be, before you write a single class?
options: 按题面顺序先定义完 Customer、Cart、CartItem、三个 Discount 子类、PriceResult，最后再讲引擎怎么串
先把三种折扣未来可能的扩展点全列出来，画一张完整类图，确认没有遗漏之后再动手写第一个类
先说一句主流程骨架：computeTotal 算 subtotal、逐个 apply 折扣、返回 PriceResult
先问面试官期望用继承还是组合、要不要考虑并发，等他给了建模方向再决定从哪个类下手
options_en: Define the entities in prompt order — Customer, Cart, CartItem, three Discount subclasses, PriceResult — and explain how the engine ties them together at the end.
List every future extension point for the three discount kinds first, draw a complete class diagram, and only start coding once nothing is missing.
Say the driver in one line: computeTotal takes the subtotal, applies each discount in turn, and returns a PriceResult.
Ask the interviewer whether they want inheritance or composition and whether concurrency matters, then decide which class to start from.
tradeoff: 骨架先行 vs 实体先行：先给主流程，面试官能跟着验证每个类为什么存在；先堆实体，省下的开场 30 秒会在他反复追问「怎么拼」时加倍还回去。
why: 面试官两次问「how does this all stitch together」，正是因为驱动方法最后才出现。先给一句 driver，之后每个类都是这句话的零件。
why_en: Open with the one-line driver — subtotal, then apply each discount, then return a result — so every class you define afterwards is visibly a piece of that flow.
whenOtherWins: 只有当面试官明说「先把领域模型列出来、流程我们一会儿再聊」，才该先铺实体。
diagram:
flowchart LR
    A["computeTotal(cart, discounts)"] --> B["1. subtotal = 各 item 行小计求和"]
    B --> C["2. 逐个 discount.apply(cart) 累加扣减额"]
    C --> D["3. 返回 PriceResult(subtotal, finalTotal, applied)"]

先把类图画到完整再动手。
开场先给一句驱动方法。
把建模方向交给面试官定。
optionMeanings_en: Entities first, driver last.
Finish the whole class diagram before coding.
Open with the driver method.
Hand the modelling direction to the interviewer.

有充裕时间做设计评审时才行。
本题 30 分钟且要跑通主流程。
题面真有歧义时才该先问。

Fits a design review with plenty of time, not a 30-minute round.
Fits this round: 30 minutes and a flow that must run end to end.
Worth asking only when the prompt is genuinely ambiguous.

30 分钟被画图吃掉，代码写不完。

scenario: OOD 轮，你已经定义完 Customer / Cart / CartItem / 三个 Discount 子类 / PriceResult，面试官两次说出「how does this all stitch together?」。
scenario_en: In the OOD round you have defined Customer, Cart, CartItem, three Discount subclasses and PriceResult, and the interviewer says twice: "how does this all stitch together?"
q: 听到「how does this all stitch together?」，缺的是什么、怎么补？
q_en: What is missing when you hear "how does this all stitch together?", and how do you recover?
text: 这句话不是好奇，是在说我缺了{{主流程骨架}}；补法是立刻给一句 driver——{{computeTotal}}(cart, discounts) 先算 subtotal、再逐个 apply、最后返回 {{PriceResult}}，而不是继续加类。
text_en: That question is not curiosity — it says I never stated the {{driver}}; recover by saying computeTotal takes the subtotal, applies each discount, and returns a {{PriceResult}}, instead of adding more classes.
why: 这是面试官在提示他看不见主流程。听到它就用一句 driver 补上，继续铺类只会让他更找不到入口。
why_en: That question is the interviewer telling you he cannot see the main flow, so answer it with one driver sentence rather than defining yet another class.

q: 把 checkout 价格引擎 OOD 的开场顺序排对
q_en: Put the opening moves of the checkout price engine OOD in the right order.
steps: 写 PercentDiscount 和 BuyXGetYDiscount 的 apply 实现
一句主流程：computeTotal 算 subtotal、逐个 apply、返回 PriceResult
声明接口契约：apply(cart) 返回要从当前总价扣掉的金额
跟面试官对一遍两个示例的期望输出
定义这条流程需要的类：Cart、CartItem、Discount 抽象类、PriceResult
why: 顺序本身就是分数：先确认输出、再给骨架、再定契约，类和实现放最后。跳过前三步就会被问「这些怎么拼」。
why_en: The order is the signal: confirm the expected output, state the driver, pin the interface contract, and only then build classes and write implementations.
diagram:
flowchart TD
    S1["对示例，确认期望输出"] --> S2["一句主流程骨架"]
    S2 --> S3["声明 apply 的返回契约"]
    S3 --> S4["定义流程需要的类"]
    S4 --> S5["写各子类的 apply"]

scenario: 同一个 Amazon loop 里，OOD 轮和系统设计轮都被追问「这些怎么串起来」——同一个失败模式在两轮各出现一次。
scenario_en: In the same Amazon loop, both the OOD round and the system design round ended up with the interviewer asking how the pieces fit together — the same failure mode twice.
q: 下次上场前，该固化成开场动作的是哪一条？
q_en: Which one move should become your fixed opening for the next loop?
options: 每轮开场先花两分钟做需求澄清，把功能与非功能需求都列全，之后再谈任何结构上的取舍
两类题同一个动作开场：先点名协调者和它的三步时序
分题型准备模板，OOD 用类图模板、系统设计用组件清单模板，上场照着模板往里填
把语速放慢、多用一二三分点，让面试官更容易跟上你铺组件和铺类的顺序，减少误解
options_en: Spend two minutes on requirements clarification at the top of every round, listing functional and non-functional needs before touching structure.
Use the same opening in both: name the coordinator and its three-step sequence.
Prepare per-format templates: a class-diagram template for OOD, a component-checklist template for system design, and fill them in live.
Slow down and enumerate first, second, third so the interviewer can follow the order in which you lay out components and classes.
tradeoff: 统一开场动作 vs 分题型套模板：一个动作两类题通用，练一次就迁移；模板能把白板填满，却仍然没有一条能走通的主流程。
why: 两轮问的其实是同一件事：谁在协调、按什么顺序。把「命名协调者 + 三步时序」练成肌肉记忆，两类题一起覆盖。
why_en: Both rounds were asking the same thing — who coordinates and in what order — so drilling that single opening move covers OOD and system design at once.
whenOtherWins: 如果面试官开场就说「先跟我把需求和规模对齐」，那就先澄清，骨架句放在澄清之后的第一句。
optionMeanings: 把需求澄清当成固定开场。
先点名协调者和它的时序。
按题型各套一份填空模板。
靠语速和分点改善可跟随性。
optionMeanings_en: Make requirements clarification the fixed opening.
Name the coordinator and its sequence first.
Keep one fill-in template per question format.
Improve followability through pacing and enumeration.
optionDirectness: 规模和范围没定的开放题需要它。
面试官两轮都在找那个协调者。
题型高度标准化时才有效。
问题在内容顺序，不在语速。
optionDirectness_en: Needed when scope and scale are genuinely undefined.
Both interviewers were hunting for that coordinator.
Works only when the question format is highly standardized.
The gap was the order of content, not the speed of speech.
optionScenarioImpacts: 澄清完还是从组件开始铺。
两轮的追问都被开场化解。
模板填满了，主流程仍然缺席。
讲得更清楚，但顺序照旧错。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: You still start from components once clarification ends.
The follow-up from both rounds is pre-empted by the opening.
The template gets filled while the main flow stays missing.
Clearer delivery, same wrong ordering.

scenario: Checkout 价格引擎：抽象类 Discount 有百分比、固定额、买X送Y 三个子类，你正准备写第一个子类。
scenario_en: Checkout price engine: the abstract Discount class has three subclasses — percent off, fixed off, buy-X-get-Y — and you are about to write the first one.
q: apply(cart) 的返回值契约该怎么定、什么时候说？
q_en: What should apply(cart) return, and when do you state that contract?
options: 返回应用折扣后的新总价，让每个子类各自算出新的 final total 再交给下一个折扣
返回 void，让每个子类直接去改 PriceResult 上的 finalTotal 字段，引擎不用管返回值
先不定，等三个子类都写完，看哪种返回值最顺手再回头统一改签名
写第一个子类前就声明：返回要从当前总价扣掉的金额，买X送Y 返回 0
options_en: Return the new total after the discount, so each subclass computes a fresh final total and hands it to the next discount.
Return void and let each subclass mutate the finalTotal field on PriceResult directly, so the engine ignores return values.
Leave it open, write all three subclasses, and unify the signature afterwards once you see which return value is handiest.
State it before the first subclass: apply returns the amount to deduct from the current total, and buy-X-get-Y returns 0.
tradeoff: 返回扣减额 vs 返回新总价：扣减额能被引擎累加、天然能回答「每笔折扣减了多少」；返回新总价少一步运算，但折扣之间的归因就丢了。
why: 契约要在写任何子类之前一句话说死。百分比返回折扣额、买X送Y 返回 0，不先声明这两件事就不自洽。
why_en: Pin the return contract in one sentence before any subclass exists, because a percent discount returning an amount and a buy-X-get-Y returning zero simply do not line up otherwise.
whenOtherWins: 若折扣必须严格串行、后一个基于前一个的结果算（叠加折扣），返回新总价反而更直白。
optionMeanings: 每个子类各自返回新总价。
子类直接改结果对象的字段。
契约留到写完子类再补。
开写前声明返回扣减额。
optionMeanings_en: Each subclass returns a fresh total.
Subclasses mutate the result object directly.
Decide the contract after the subclasses exist.
Declare up front that apply returns a deduction.
optionDirectness: 折扣必须串行叠加时才顺。
只有单一调用方且无需归因时可行。
只写一个实现类时无所谓。
有多个子类要被同一循环折叠。
optionDirectness_en: Works when discounts must compound strictly in sequence.
Tolerable only with a single caller and no need for attribution.
Harmless if there is only ever one implementation.
Fits three subclasses folded by one shared loop.
optionScenarioImpacts: 顺序敏感，且看不出每笔减了多少。
结果对象被三处写，改坏难查。
签名中途变，已写的代码要返工。
引擎循环能一行写完并累加。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Order-sensitive, and you lose per-discount attribution.
Three writers on one result object make bad writes hard to trace.
Changing the signature midway forces rewriting finished code.
The engine loop becomes one line that accumulates deductions.

scenario: 价格引擎里三个折扣子类共用一个抽象方法 apply(cart)，引擎负责把它们折叠成最终价。
scenario_en: Three discount subclasses share one abstract apply(cart) method, and the engine folds their results into the final price.
q: 背下 apply() 的契约句（写子类前要说的那句）
q_en: Memorize the apply() contract sentence you say before writing any subclass.
text: apply(cart) 返回{{从当前总价要扣掉的金额}}；BUY_X_GET_Y 返回 {{0}}，因为它是{{加赠品}}而不是扣钱；引擎把所有返回值累加，一次从 subtotal 里减。
text_en: apply(cart) returns {{the amount to deduct from the current total}}; BUY_X_GET_Y returns {{0}} because it adds free units instead of deducting; the engine sums every return value and subtracts once from the subtotal.
why: 一句话同时说清返回什么、哪个子类是例外、引擎怎么用——面试官就不需要再问「这些怎么拼」。
why_en: One sentence says what is returned, which subclass is the exception, and how the engine consumes it, which is exactly what stops the stitch-together question.

scenario: 买三送一（buy 3 get 1），顾客买了同一个商品 10 件、单价 $5，你在写 BuyXGetYDiscount.apply(cart)。
scenario_en: Buy three get one free: the customer has 10 units of the same product at $5 each, and you are writing BuyXGetYDiscount.apply(cart).
q: 这个买赠该怎么落到最终价格上？
q_en: How should this buy-X-get-Y discount reach the final price?
options: 算出免费件数 10 // 4 = 2，返回 2 × $5 的扣减额，cart 保持不动
把 cart 里对应 item 的 unitPrice 按比例调低，让平均单价自己体现出买赠的效果
遍历 cart，把送的件数直接加到那个 item 的 quantity 上，然后 apply 返回 0
直接返回 cart.subtotal() 的 25%，因为买三送一相当于每四件里免掉一件
options_en: Compute the free units, 10 // 4 = 2, return a deduction of 2 × $5, and leave the cart untouched.
Lower the unitPrice on that cart item proportionally so the average unit price reflects the free units.
Walk the cart, add the free units straight onto that item's quantity, and have apply return 0.
Return 25% of cart.subtotal(), since buy three get one means one out of every four units is free.
tradeoff: 返回扣减额 vs 改 cart 数量：扣减额让原始购物车保持原样、每笔折扣可单独归因；改数量看着直观，但原价和折扣明细都被写掉了。
why: cart 是原始凭证，改了它原价和审计轨迹就没了。买三送一 = 每 4 件免 1 件：10 // 4 = 2 件免费，减 2 × 单价。
why_en: The cart is the source of truth, so instead of mutating quantities compute the free units — 10 // 4 = 2 under buy three get one — and return two unit prices as the deduction.
whenOtherWins: 若产品要求收据上真的列出赠品行，就新增一条单价为 0 的 line item，而不是改原 item 的数量。
optionMeanings: 算出免费件数，返回扣减额。
把折扣摊进单价里。
在 apply 里直接改购物车数量。
用固定比例近似买赠效果。
optionMeanings_en: Compute free units and return a deduction.
Spread the discount into the unit price.
Mutate the cart quantity inside apply.
Approximate the promotion with a fixed percentage.
optionDirectness: 钱要可对账、cart 要保持原样。
只有对外只展示均价的场景才行。
赠品必须真实进库存单据时才用。
购物车只有这一种商品才勉强对。
optionDirectness_en: Fits money that must reconcile with an untouched cart.
Only where the customer ever sees an averaged unit price.
Only when free units must really land on the fulfilment record.
Roughly right only if the cart holds nothing else.
optionScenarioImpacts: PriceResult 能列出这笔减了 $10。
单价被改写，商品原价查不回来。
原价被覆盖，退款时对不上账。
买 10 件时按 25% 算会多减钱。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: PriceResult can show that this discount took off $10.
The rewritten unit price makes the list price unrecoverable.
The original price is overwritten and refunds stop reconciling.
At 10 units the flat 25% takes off more than it should.

scenario: 买三送一（buy X = 3, get Y = 1），同一商品买了 10 件、单价 $5，apply 要返回一个扣减额。
scenario_en: Buy three get one (buy X = 3, get Y = 1): 10 units of one product at $5 each, and apply must return a deduction amount.
q: 买三送一、买 10 件、单价 $5，扣减额怎么算？
q_en: Buy three get one, 10 units at $5 each — how do you compute the deduction?
text: 一组 = buy X + get Y = 3 + 1 = {{4}} 件；免费件数 = 10 // 4 = {{2}} 件；扣减额 = 2 × $5 = {{$10}}；引擎再用 subtotal 减掉它。
text_en: One group = buy X + get Y = 3 + 1 = {{4}} units; free units = 10 // 4 = {{2}}; deduction = 2 × $5 = {{$10}}; the engine subtracts that from the subtotal.
why: 先算「一组几件」再整除，是买赠题唯一会算错的地方；算出的扣减额直接进引擎的累加器，不需要碰 cart。
why_en: Work out the group size before dividing, because that is the only step where buy-X-get-Y arithmetic goes wrong, and the deduction then feeds straight into the engine's accumulator.

scenario: 面试官问：「你在 apply 里改了 cart 里 item 的数量，这样有什么问题？」这个价格引擎是真实收银链路的一部分。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks: "you mutated the item quantity inside the cart in apply — what's the problem with that?" This price engine sits on a real checkout path.
q: 为什么价格引擎不该改传进来的 cart？
q_en: Why shouldn't the price engine mutate the cart it was handed?
options: 因为改 cart 会让 apply 变慢——每次都要重新遍历整个 item 列表，是 O(n) 的额外开销
因为面试官偏好函数式风格，不可变对象在 code review 阶段更容易被通过
因为 Python 的 list 不是线程安全的，多个折扣并发 apply 时会把数量写坏
因为 cart 是原始凭证：改了它就丢掉了原价和「每笔折扣减了多少」的审计轨迹
options_en: Because mutating the cart makes apply slower — you re-walk the whole item list every time, an extra O(n) pass.
Because interviewers prefer a functional style and immutable objects pass code review more easily.
Because a Python list is not thread-safe, so concurrent apply calls would corrupt the quantities.
Because the cart is the original record: mutate it and you lose the list price and the per-discount audit trail.
tradeoff: 只读 cart + 独立结果对象 vs 就地改 cart：多一个 PriceResult 对象的成本，换来原价、折扣明细、最终价三者能互相对账。
why: 钱相关的东西必须可审计：cart 保持原样，PriceResult 单独承载 subtotal、finalTotal 和已应用折扣清单。
why_en: Anything touching money has to be auditable, so leave the cart untouched and let a separate PriceResult carry the subtotal, the final total, and the discounts applied.
whenOtherWins: 只有离线批量重算、且原始 cart 已另存快照时，就地改写才可以接受。
optionMeanings: 把问题归到时间复杂度上。
把问题归到代码风格偏好上。
把问题归到并发安全上。
把问题归到可审计性上。
optionMeanings_en: Frames it as a time-complexity problem.
Frames it as a style preference.
Frames it as a concurrency-safety problem.
Frames it as an auditability problem.
optionDirectness: 在超大购物车上才值得提。
团队规范强制不可变时才算理由。
同一个 cart 真被并发处理时成立。
结算链路要对账、要能退款。
optionDirectness_en: Worth raising only for very large carts.
A reason only where the team mandates immutability.
Holds only if one cart is genuinely processed concurrently.
Fits a checkout path that must reconcile and support refunds.
optionScenarioImpacts: 答成性能题，错过了钱的正确性。
听起来像迎合，不像工程理由。
本题折扣是串行 apply，并不成立。
把话题带到 PriceResult 的必要性。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Turns it into a performance answer and misses correctness of money.
Sounds like pleasing the interviewer rather than engineering.
Discounts here are applied serially, so it does not apply.
Leads naturally into why PriceResult has to exist.

scenario: 你没声明 apply 的返回契约就开写：PercentDiscount 返回折扣额，BuyXGetYDiscount 返回 0 并顺手改了 item 数量。
scenario_en: You started coding without declaring the apply contract: PercentDiscount returns a discount amount while BuyXGetYDiscount returns 0 and quietly mutates item quantities.
q: 这种不一致最先在哪里炸出来？
q_en: Where does that inconsistency blow up first?
options: 在引擎里：它要把返回值累加成 total_discount，但买赠的减免不在返回值里
在 PercentDiscount 里：百分比乘 subtotal 会产生浮点误差，最后金额对不上分
在 Cart 里：addItem 没有加锁，两个折扣同时写入时会出现丢更新
在 PriceResult 里：appliedCoupons 列表没有去重，同一张券可能被记两次
options_en: In the engine: it wants to sum return values into total_discount, but the buy-X-get-Y reduction isn't in the return value.
In PercentDiscount: multiplying a percentage by the subtotal introduces float error and the cents stop matching.
In Cart: addItem takes no lock, so two discounts writing at once produce a lost update.
In PriceResult: the appliedCoupons list is not deduplicated, so one coupon can be recorded twice.
why: 接口语义不统一时，第一个受害者永远是调用方——引擎写不出一条统一的折叠规则。契约先行就是先给调用方一个能写的循环。
why_en: When the interface semantics drift, the caller breaks first, because the engine has no single rule it can fold every discount with.
optionMeanings: 问题落在调用方的折叠逻辑上。
问题落在浮点精度上。
问题落在并发写上。
问题落在结果列表的去重上。
optionMeanings_en: The break lands on the caller's folding logic.
The break lands on floating-point precision.
The break lands on concurrent writes.
The break lands on deduplicating the result list.
optionDirectness: 两个子类返回值语义不同就会发生。
金额用浮点表示时是真实风险。
同一 cart 被多线程处理时才成立。
同一张券被重复传入时才出现。
optionDirectness_en: Happens as soon as two subclasses mean different things by their return.
A real risk when money is held in floats.
Only holds if one cart is processed by several threads.
Only shows up when the same coupon is passed twice.
optionScenarioImpacts: 引擎的 for 循环没法写成一行。

scenario: Amazon HM 轮系统设计：给卖家做 GenAI messenger（自然语言提问、基于业务上下文检索、流式返回）。白板上你刚画了 client 和 API gateway。

q: 下一句话该说什么，才不会被反复追问？

options: 抽象讲原则：把稳定字段和动态配置字段分开，核心记录才不会因为配置改动被频繁重写，具体列名等对方追问了再补上

scenario: 你已经口头给出 campaigns 和 campaign_configs 两张表，配置（预算上限、ROI 目标、生效区间）会被频繁调整。面试官问：「为什么不放一张表？」
scenario_en: You've named campaigns and campaign_configs out loud, and the configs — budget cap, ROI target, validity window — change often. The interviewer asks why not keep it in one table.
q: 拆成两张表买到了什么？
q_en: What does splitting it into two tables actually buy you?
options: 买到自动分片能力：建了外键之后数据库会按 campaign_id 把两张表分到同一个分片上
买到更快的全表扫描：campaigns 列变少，扫描时读的数据页更少，报表查询会明显变快
买到配置可版本化：改配置只写 configs 新行，主记录不动，历史按生效区间可查
买到更强的一致性：两张表可以放进同一个事务，配置和主记录之间不会出现中间状态
options_en: Automatic sharding: once there's a foreign key the database co-locates both tables on the same shard by campaign_id.
Faster full scans: campaigns has fewer columns, so scans read fewer pages and reporting queries get noticeably quicker.
Versioned configuration: a change writes a new configs row, the campaigns record stays put, and history is queryable by validity window.
Stronger consistency: both tables can sit in one transaction so config and core record never show an intermediate state.
tradeoff: 拆表 vs 宽表：拆表让配置版本化、主记录稳定，代价是读当前配置要多一次 join 或多一次查询。
why: 一对多关系让配置随时间变化而不动核心记录；索引建在 campaign_id 上，查某个 campaign 的配置就是一次范围查找。
why_en: The one-to-many link lets configuration change over time without touching the core record, and an index on campaign_id turns "give me this campaign's configs" into one range lookup.
whenOtherWins: 如果配置字段极少、几乎不改、也不需要历史，一张宽表更省一次查询。

options_en: Start typing and explain each line as it appears, so the interviewer watches your thinking evolve in real time.
Write the function signature and two or three test cases first, so you and the interviewer agree on inputs and outputs.
Ask about the expected time complexity and whether the standard library is allowed before deciding how to write it.

scenario: Amazon Round 2 编码：给 7 张字母牌、一份字母分值、一份合法单词表，返回能拼出的 Top-5 高分词。
scenario_en: Amazon round 2 coding: given seven letter tiles, a letter-score map and a list of valid words, return the top five scoring words you can build.
q: 写第一个循环之前该先说清什么？
q_en: What do you state before writing the first loop?
options: 先说复杂度目标：单词表可能上万条，所以筛选要控制在总字母数量级的时间内完成
先说三个输入各自的表示：手牌用什么容器、分值用什么、单词表怎么遍历
先说排序规则：按分数降序、同分按字母序，这决定了最后取前五那一步怎么写
先说边界情况：能拼的词不足五个、单词表里有重复词、手上还有空白牌怎么办
options_en: State the complexity target: the word list may hold tens of thousands, so filtering must stay near the total-letters scale.
State how each of the three inputs is represented: which container holds the hand, the scores, and how you walk the words.
State the ordering rule: score descending, ties alphabetical — that decides how the final top-five slice is written.
State the edge cases: fewer than five buildable words, duplicate words in the list, and blank wildcard tiles.
tradeoff: 先声明容器 vs 直接开写：先说清 key/value 和容器，面试官能在你写循环前纠偏；直接开写，换结构就得推翻已经写好的代码。
why: Sid 明确认可这个 mental model；也正因为先说清了，他把手牌从 dict 引到长度 26 的 list 时我能干净切换。
why_en: The interviewer explicitly liked that mental model, and because the representations were stated first I could switch the hand from a dict to a length-26 list without throwing away code.
whenOtherWins: 如果题目已经给死了输入结构（比如给了类定义），就跳过这步，直接说算法主线。

scenario_en: Startup coding question: implement an AgentRegistry supporting register, get, remove and list with a filter.

scenario: Apple 系统设计轮：设计「批量移动邮件」——用户一次选中几万封邮件移到另一个文件夹，后台异步执行。你有 5 分钟白板。
scenario_en: Apple system design round: design bulk email move — a user selects tens of thousands of emails and moves them to another folder, executed asynchronously. You have five minutes of whiteboard.
q: 这 5 分钟里，第一条该先讲什么？
q_en: In those five minutes, which beat comes first?
options: 先讲鉴权：请求进来第一步校验这个用户对源文件夹和目标文件夹都有权限
先讲队列：用 Kafka 还是普通消息队列，分区数怎么定，消费者组怎么扩容
先讲进度展示：前端每隔几秒轮询一次 job 状态，把已处理条数显示给用户看
先讲分批：把几万封邮件切成每批 500 封的 task，控制单个 task 的执行时长
options_en: Start with authorization: step one checks that this user may read the source folder and write the destination.
Start with the queue: Kafka or a plain message queue, how many partitions, how the consumer group scales.
Start with progress: the front end polls job status every few seconds and shows the processed count to the user.
Start with batching: split tens of thousands of emails into tasks of about 500 to bound each task's runtime.
tradeoff: 鉴权先行 vs 吞吐先行：先划权限边界，后面每个组件都在「已授权」的前提下讨论；先讲吞吐，等于默认所有请求都合法。
why: 批量操作会放大一切，包括越权。先定「谁能对哪些对象做什么」，是这张清单里最便宜、也最先被期待的一条。
why_en: A bulk operation amplifies everything, including a permission mistake, so defining who may do what to which objects is the cheapest and most expected beat to lead with.
whenOtherWins: 如果面试官明说「鉴权我们假定已经做好，直接讲执行路径」，就跳过这条，从分批和幂等开始。

termDefinitions.meaning: Kafka：分布式日志式消息系统，按分区顺序写、支持多消费者组重放，常用于高吞吐事件流。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Kafka is a distributed log-style messaging system that writes in order per partition and lets multiple consumer groups replay, which suits high-throughput event streams.

scenario: Apple 批量移动邮件那轮，每一条资深升级点都是被提示才说出来的。现在把这张清单背下来，下次主动抛。
scenario_en: In the Apple bulk-email-move round, every senior upgrade had to be prompted out of you. Memorize the checklist so you volunteer it next time.
q: 异步批处理里，哪些属于要主动抛的资深升级点？
q_en: In an asynchronous batch design, which beats should you volunteer unprompted?
options: task 幂等：用去重键保证重试的移动不会被重复写一遍
通用操作模型：存 task_type 和 task_payload，别把源/目标文件夹写死进表结构
服务端驱动完成：processed 等于 total 时由服务端置终态并推送，不等 UI 来标
结果预生成：报表在 job 最后一步生成好，之后每次 GET 只读不重算
worker 单线程串行执行：一次只处理一个 task，从根上避免并发带来的顺序问题
options_en: Idempotent tasks: a dedup key means a retried move is not written twice.
Generic operation model: store task_type and task_payload instead of hard-coding source and destination folders.
Server-driven completion: when processed equals total the server sets the terminal state and pushes, rather than waiting for the UI.
Precomputed result: the report is produced as the job's final stage, so later GETs only read.
Single-threaded workers: process one task at a time to rule out ordering problems from concurrency.
why: 前四条各自挡住一个真实故障：重复写、需求变更时改表、状态挂在客户端、报表每次重算。第五条是把吞吐让掉换确定性，不是资深信号。
why_en: The first four each block a real failure — double writes, schema churn on new requirements, terminal state hostage to a client, and a report recomputed on every read — while serializing workers just trades throughput for determinism.
optionMeanings: 去重键挡住重试导致的重复写。
字段化操作类型，新需求不用改表。
终态由持有计数的一方宣布。
把重算压力从读路径挪到 job 末尾。
用串行换确定性，吞吐直接受限。
optionMeanings_en: A dedup key blocks double writes on retry.
Field-encoded operation type means new requirements skip schema changes.
The side holding the counter declares the terminal state.
Moves recompute cost off the read path into the job's tail.
Trades throughput for determinism and caps scale.

报表会被反复打开时必需。
只有顺序本身是业务要求时才选。

The next bulk delete needs no schema change.

scenario: 批量移动邮件的 job 会被重试，产品之后还想加批量删除、批量打标签。
scenario_en: The bulk email move job gets retried, and the product later wants bulk delete and bulk labelling too.
q: 背下异步批处理里最先被追问的两条
q_en: Memorize the two beats an interviewer probes first in async batch design.
text: ① task 要{{幂等}}——用去重键保证重试的移动不会重复写；② 操作模型要通用——存 {{task_type}} + {{task_payload}}，别把源/目标文件夹写死进表结构。
text_en: First, tasks must be {{idempotent}} — a dedup key keeps a retried move from writing twice. Second, keep the operation model generic: store {{task_type}} and {{task_payload}} instead of hard-coding source and destination folders.
why: 这两条一个挡住重复写、一个挡住需求一变就改表；都是被提示才说 = 白丢的资深分。
why_en: One blocks double writes and the other blocks a schema change every time a new bulk operation appears, and having to be prompted for either is a senior signal thrown away.

scenario: 批量移动邮件的 job 在后台跑，可能持续几分钟，用户随时可能关掉页面。前端需要知道什么时候算完成。
scenario_en: The bulk move job runs in the background for minutes and the user may close the tab at any point. The front end still needs to know when it's done.
q: 「完成」这个状态该由谁判定？
q_en: Who gets to declare the job complete?
options: 由前端：轮询到已处理条数等于总数时，前端把这个 job 标记为 completed
由服务端：processed 等于 total 时服务端置终态，并把完成事件推送给客户端
由 worker：最后一个 task 执行完时，那个 worker 自己把 job 状态改成 completed
由定时任务：每分钟扫一遍进行中的 job，把满足条件的那些批量置成完成
options_en: The front end: when polling shows processed equals total, the client marks the job completed.
The server: when processed equals total it sets the terminal state and pushes a completion event to the client.
The worker: whichever worker finishes the last task flips the job status to completed itself.
A cron job: sweep in-progress jobs every minute and bulk-mark the ones that qualify as complete.
tradeoff: 服务端置终态并推送 vs 客户端轮询判定：服务端判定让状态只有一个来源，代价是要维护推送通道；轮询实现简单，但用户关掉页面这个 job 就没人宣布完成。
why: 完成是业务事实，只能由持有计数的服务端宣布。让 UI 判定，等于把终态挂在一个随时会被关掉的客户端上。
why_en: Completion is a business fact that only the server holding the counter can declare, and letting the UI decide hangs the terminal state on a client that can vanish.
whenOtherWins: 内部工具、并发很小、能接受几秒延迟时，客户端轮询更省事，不必上推送通道。

终态由服务端判定并推送。
终态由最后完成的 worker 写入。
终态由周期扫描批量补写。

The server decides and pushes the terminal state.
The last finishing worker writes the terminal state.
A periodic sweep backfills terminal states in bulk.

Usable in offline flows that tolerate minute-level lag.

scenario: 批量移动完成后要给用户一份结果报表（哪些成功、哪些失败）。用户会反复打开这个结果页。
scenario_en: After the bulk move finishes, the user gets a result report listing successes and failures — and they reopen that page repeatedly.
q: 这份结果报表该在什么时候生成？
q_en: When should that result report be generated?
options: 每次 GET 时按 task 表实时聚合，保证用户每次看到的都是最新的状态
由前端生成：把所有 task 结果拉到浏览器里再聚合，顺便减轻服务端的计算压力
在 job 的最后一步生成好并落到对象存储，之后 GET 只读不重算
用定时任务每 5 分钟重算一次并覆盖旧结果，兼顾新鲜度和服务端开销
options_en: Aggregate from the task table on every GET so the user always sees the freshest state.
Generate it in the browser: pull all task results to the client and aggregate there, easing server load.
Produce it as the job's final stage, store it in object storage, and let later GETs only read.
Recompute it every five minutes with a cron job and overwrite, balancing freshness against server cost.
tradeoff: 完成时预生成 vs 每次 GET 重算：预生成把重复 GET 变成一次读，代价是多一份存储和一个过期策略；实时聚合永远最新，但每次刷新都重扫一遍 task 表。
why: job 结束时结果已经不会再变，重复 GET 重算的是同一份答案。把它做成 job 的最后一个 stage，GET 就退化成一次读。
why_en: Once the job ends the result stops changing, so every repeated GET recomputes the same answer; make it the job's final stage and a GET becomes a single read.
whenOtherWins: 如果 job 完成后结果还会被后续流程改动（比如失败项会自动重试），那就得实时聚合或带上版本号。
optionMeanings: 读路径每次都重新聚合。
把聚合搬到浏览器里做。
写路径末尾一次性生成。
用周期任务定时刷新快照。
optionMeanings_en: Re-aggregates on every read.
Moves the aggregation into the browser.
Produces it once at the end of the write path.
Refreshes a snapshot on a fixed schedule.
optionDirectness: 结果仍会变动时才需要实时。
结果条数很少时勉强可行。
结果在 job 结束后不再变化。
结果会缓慢变化时是折中解。

q: 把「批量移动邮件」异步 job 的五个环节排对
q_en: Put the five stages of the bulk email move job in the right order.
steps: worker 逐个 task 幂等执行移动，写入前先查去重键
服务端检测到 processed 等于 total，推送完成事件给客户端
校验这个用户对源文件夹和目标文件夹的权限
job 的最后一步预生成结果报表，之后 GET 只读不重算
把选中的邮件切成批，生成带 task_type 和 task_payload 的 task 入队
why: 这五步就是我要在 5 分钟白板上一口气讲完的骨架：权限、入队、幂等执行、预生成报表、服务端宣布完成。
why_en: These five stages are the skeleton to deliver in one breath on a five-minute whiteboard: authorize, enqueue, execute idempotently, precompute the report, and let the server declare completion.

scenario: 系统设计轮，你刚讲完 GenAI messenger 的组件图。HM 直接问：「你觉得这个架构的扩展瓶颈在哪？」你答得偏慢。
scenario_en: System design round: you've just finished the GenAI messenger component diagram and the hiring manager asks straight out where the scaling bottleneck is. You answer slowly.
q: 这个提问暴露了什么，下次怎么改？
q_en: What does that question expose, and what changes next time?
options: 暴露我图画得不够清楚，下次该把每个组件的每秒处理量和延迟预算都标在方框上
暴露我漏了非功能需求，下次该在开头就把可用性和延迟目标全部列出来
暴露我没主动交底：讲完架构就该自己说「瓶颈是 X，因为 Y，我这样缓解」
暴露我选的组件不合适，下次该换成更容易水平扩展的托管服务来替代
options_en: It exposes an unclear diagram; next time annotate each box with its throughput.
It exposes missing non-functional requirements; next time list availability and latency targets up front.
It exposes that I never volunteered it: after the architecture I should say the bottleneck is X because Y, and here's the relief.
It exposes poor component choices; next time swap in managed services that scale horizontally more easily.
tradeoff: 主动交底 vs 等着被问：主动说瓶颈把话题留在我准备好的深水区，代价是要先想清哪一条最先撑不住；等被问，节奏和方向都归面试官。
why: 瓶颈分析是系统设计里区分度最高的一段。让面试官开口问，等于把这段的主动权让出去。
why_en: Bottleneck analysis is where system design rounds separate people, so waiting to be asked hands that whole section over to the interviewer.
whenOtherWins: 如果时间只剩两三分钟，把主干讲完整比展开瓶颈更重要——先收口，再补一句最可能的瓶颈。

scenario: 编码题：每天 ingest 一份汇率文件更新内存里的结构，运行时另有请求查 source→target 的汇率。面试官一步步把你带到正确结构。
scenario_en: Coding question: a rate file is ingested daily to refresh an in-memory structure, while separate runtime requests ask for a source-to-target rate. The interviewer walked you to the right shape step by step.
q: 题面里哪个信号本该让你自己先提出结构？
q_en: Which cue in the prompt should have made you propose the structure yourself?
options: 「汇率」这个词——金融数值要保精度，所以该先提用定点小数而不是浮点数
「中间货币」这个词——需要在图上做遍历，所以该先提用队列扩展和 visited 集合
「内存」这个词——数据量可能超出内存，所以该先提分片和落盘的策略
「每天一份文件 + 运行时查询」——低频写、高频读，该主动提有状态类加两个方法
options_en: The word "rate": financial numbers need precision, so propose fixed-point decimals rather than floats.
The words "intermediate currency": you need graph traversal, so propose a queue-based expansion with a visited set.
The word "memory": the data may not fit, so propose sharding and spilling to disk.
"A file every day plus runtime queries": low-frequency writes and high-frequency reads mean a stateful class with two methods.
tradeoff: 主动提结构 vs 被一步步引导：主动提，这题从「写一个函数」升级成「设计一个小系统」；被引导过去，同样的代码只拿到跟随分。
why: 题面同时给了「周期性加载」和「运行时查询」两个频率，这就是读写分离的提示。我当时还想把三个参数塞进同一个方法。
why_en: When a prompt names both a periodic load and a runtime query it is asking for a stateful class with separate ingest and read methods, not one function taking every parameter.
whenOtherWins: 如果输入只来一次、之后不再更新，一个函数就够，硬套类结构反而是过度设计。
optionMeanings: 把信号读成数值精度问题。
把信号读成遍历算法问题。
把信号读成容量问题。
把信号读成读写频率分离。
optionMeanings_en: Reads the cue as a numeric-precision problem.
Reads the cue as a traversal-algorithm problem.
Reads the cue as a capacity problem.
Reads the cue as separating read and write frequency.
optionDirectness: 确实该注意，但不是结构信号。
决定算法，不决定类怎么切。
全球货币集合很小，不成立。
两种频率被同时写进了题面。
optionDirectness_en: Worth noting, but it is not a structural cue.
Decides the algorithm, not how the class is split.
The global currency set is small, so it does not apply.
Both frequencies are written into the prompt itself.
optionScenarioImpacts: 答成精度题，结构仍然缺席。
算法说清了，加载路径没人管。
为不存在的规模问题做设计。
自己先提出加载方法和查询方法。

scenario: OOD 轮，你在抽象类 Discount 上放了 isEligible()。面试官问：「百分比折扣的 isEligible 长什么样？」当前三种折扣都没有门槛。
scenario_en: OOD round: you put isEligible() on the abstract Discount class and the interviewer asks what isEligible looks like for a percent discount. None of the three current discounts has a threshold.
q: 该怎么回应这个追问？
q_en: How should you respond to that probe?
options: 举一个满减例子撑住它：满 $100 减 30%，说明每种折扣其实都需要 isEligible
承认现在三种折扣都不需要它，从抽象类删掉，资格检查下沉进 apply
保留 isEligible，但给它一个默认返回 true 的实现，子类需要时再去覆盖它
把它提到一个单独的 EligibilityRule 接口，用组合替代继承，保持扩展性
options_en: Defend it with a threshold example — spend $100 to get 30% off — arguing every discount really does need isEligible.
Agree that none of the three needs it, drop it from the abstract class, and push the eligibility check into apply.
Keep isEligible but give it a default returning true, so subclasses override it only when they need to.
Extract it into a separate EligibilityRule interface, favouring composition over inheritance to keep it extensible.
tradeoff: 最小抽象 vs 预留钩子：最小抽象让每个方法都有真实调用方，代价是将来真有门槛规则时要改签名；预留钩子省下那次改动，但抽象类上先躺着一个没人调用的方法。
why: 抽象类上放一个没有真实用例的方法，就是投机性泛化。删掉它、把检查下沉到 apply，是很强的不过度设计信号。
why_en: A method on an abstract class with no real caller is speculative generality, so removing it and pushing the check into apply reads as a strong don't-over-design signal.
whenOtherWins: 如果题目已经给出两种以上带门槛的券（满减、限新客），资格判断就有了真实用例，抽出接口才合理。
optionMeanings: 临时编一个用例来保住方法。
删掉抽象方法，检查下沉。
留着方法，给个空实现。
把资格规则拆成独立接口。
optionMeanings_en: Invents a use case on the spot to keep the method.
Removes the abstract method and pushes the check down.
Keeps the method with an empty default.
Extracts eligibility into its own interface.
optionDirectness: 真有门槛券时这个例子才成立。
三个子类里没有一个需要它。
多数子类需要、少数不需要时合适。
已有多种独立门槛规则时才划算。
optionDirectness_en: The example only holds once threshold coupons actually exist.
Fits the case where none of the three subclasses needs it.
Fits when most subclasses need it and a few do not.
Pays off only once several independent rules exist.
optionScenarioImpacts: 为一个不存在的需求撑住抽象。
抽象缩小，每个方法都有调用方。
方法留着，仍然没有真实调用方。
在 30 分钟里多造一层没人用的接口。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Props up an abstraction for a requirement that does not exist.

scenario: 面试官质疑你在抽象类上多放的方法时，这是要主动说出口的那句话（Round 1 里这是被认可的正向信号）。
scenario_en: This is the line to volunteer when an interviewer questions an extra method on your abstract class — it read as a positive signal in round 1.
q: 背下那句主动说出口的 YAGNI 台词
q_en: Memorize the YAGNI line you volunteer out loud.
text: 「我先让抽象保持{{最小}}，等{{真实需求}}出现再扩展。」YAGNI = {{You Aren't Gonna Need It}}，说的是别为还没到来的需求提前造抽象。
text_en: "I'll keep the abstraction {{minimal}} and extend it when a {{real requirement}} shows up." YAGNI stands for {{You Aren't Gonna Need It}} — don't build abstractions for requirements that haven't arrived.
why: 同样的取舍，被追问才承认 = 被动；主动说出来 = 一个刻意的工程判断。
why_en: Same tradeoff, different signal: conceding it under questioning reads as passive, while volunteering it reads as a deliberate engineering call.

termDefinitions.meaning: You Aren't Gonna Need It（你不会需要它）：只实现当前真实需要的功能，不为设想中的未来需求提前造抽象。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: You Aren't Gonna Need It means building only what is needed right now, instead of adding abstractions for imagined future requirements.

scenario: 同一个开场动作要在两类题上复用：OOD（checkout 价格引擎）和系统设计（GenAI messenger）。
scenario_en: One opening move has to work in both formats: OOD (the checkout price engine) and system design (the GenAI messenger).
q: 两类题的骨架句差在哪、共同点是什么？
q_en: How do the skeleton sentences differ across the two formats, and what stays the same?
options: OOD 说复杂度，系统设计说每秒请求量，两者都是先给一个量化指标
OOD 说类的继承关系，系统设计说组件清单，两者都是先把结构铺开
OOD 说数据结构选型，系统设计说存储选型，两者都是先定数据落在哪
OOD 说方法签名加三步，系统设计说服务名加时序，两者都是先点名协调者
options_en: OOD states complexity, system design states requests per second — both lead with a quantitative target.
OOD states the inheritance tree, system design states the component list — both lead by laying out structure.
OOD states the data structure, system design states the storage engine — both lead by fixing where data lands.
OOD states a method signature plus three steps, system design a service name plus a sequence — both name the coordinator.
tradeoff: 同一动作两种落点 vs 每种题型各套一份模板：同一动作只练一次就能迁移，但要求我在每类题里都先找出那个协调者；套模板不用找，却填不出一条主流程。
why: 两类题的骨架句形状不同（一个是方法、一个是服务），但做的是同一件事：先命名协调者，再给它的三步时序。
why_en: The skeleton sentence takes a different shape in each format — a method in one, a service in the other — but does the same job: name the coordinator, then give its three-step sequence.
optionMeanings: 认为骨架就是一个量化指标。
认为骨架就是结构清单。
认为骨架就是数据落点。
认为骨架是协调者加时序。
optionMeanings_en: Treats the skeleton as a quantitative target.
Treats the skeleton as a structural inventory.
Treats the skeleton as where data lands.
Treats the skeleton as coordinator plus sequence.
optionDirectness: 指标能定范围，定不了顺序。
清单正是两轮都失分的做法。
存储很重要，但不构成主流程。
两轮面试官找的都是这个东西。
optionDirectness_en: A target bounds scope but not sequence.
The inventory is exactly what lost points in both rounds.
Storage matters but does not form a main flow.
This is what both interviewers were hunting for.

白板铺满，还是会被追问。
存储定了，上层时序依旧空白。
一个动作两类题通用。

The board fills up and the same follow-up still comes.
Storage is settled while the sequence above it stays blank.
One move that transfers across both formats.
